title: 2.1 HTML Basics
description: HTML tags, elements, document structure and attributes

questions.question: What is HTML?
options: A markup language used to create webpages
A programming language used to run software
A database language used to store records
An operating system used to manage hardware
questions.correctAnswer: A markup language used to create webpages

questions.question: The different elements of a webpage such as headings, tables, paragraphs, and images are defined using what?
options: The predefined set of markup tags of HTML
The predefined set of formulas of a spreadsheet
The predefined set of queries of a database
The predefined set of commands of an operating system
questions.correctAnswer: The predefined set of markup tags of HTML
